summary: Batch scheduler jobs failing 403 due to duplicated tenant header from customer edge
description:
Issue summary: Several scheduled batch inference jobs from Datawave Health's private deployment are receiving 403 Authorization responses when invoking Redwood's ingest route. Impact: scheduled workers failing to process nightly jobs; customer reports ~100% failure for scheduled tasks and manual runs succeed from the console. Environment: Private VPC deployment in us-east behind customer-managed edge proxy.

Observed behavior: Jobs queued by the customer's scheduler include an X-Tenant header; the customer's edge proxy is rewriting/duplicating that header into two values (one empty and one correct). Redwood's identity-proxy is resolving tenant from the first header entry and failing tenant mapping, resulting in RBAC deny (403).

Why this ticket: Customer asked for immediate workaround and fix because nightly processing is blocked and they are in an enterprise compliance window.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) In a private VPC deployment behind a managed edge, queue a scheduled batch job that sets X-Tenant: tenant-xyz and Authorization: Bearer <service-token>.
2) Upgrade or configure the customer's edge to add a routing annotation that causes header folding/duplication (customer's proxy behavior).
3) Observe Redwood identity-proxy logs: multiple X-Tenant header values received; first value is empty; tenant resolution fails and request returns 403.
4) Manually invoking the same endpoint from the console with correctly-formed single header succeeds.
Expected: identity-proxy should deterministically resolve the tenant when multiple header values are present or at least log a clear error and surface a helpful diagnostic to the customer.
logs: 2026-03-13T02:12:07Z identity-proxy[auth] tenant_resolve ERROR tenant_lookup failed for value="" -> mapping not found
comments: 2026-03-13 03:01 - Support (Avery): Acknowledged ticket. Asked customer for edge proxy config and raw request captures. Assigned to Diego.

2026-03-13 05:24 - Customer (Emily Zhao, Datawave): Sent proxy config and tcpdump showing duplicate headers after an ingress upgrade. Notes that only scheduled jobs are impacted; interactive console calls are fine.

2026-03-13 09:12 - Eng (Diego): Reproduced locally by injecting duplicated X-Tenant header; confirmed identity-proxy currently reads the first header value and does not dedupe. Adding investigation notes.

2026-03-13 16:40 - Support (Avery): Provided customer short-term workaround: add an edge rewrite rule to collapse X-Tenant to the last non-empty value or strip empty values. Customer will test overnight and report back.

2026-03-14 08:10 - Customer (Emily): Workaround tested; overnight jobs succeeded when edge rule applied. Requests that still had duplicated headers without rewrite are failing. Asked for upstream fix so they don't need the workaround permanently.
investigation_notes: Hypothesis: Customer-managed edge (recent upgrade) started emitting duplicate headers where an initial empty header followed by correct tenant is produced. Identity-proxy uses the first header token for tenant resolution; empty string resolves to no tenant and triggers RBAC deny.

Reproduction steps executed in staging: Send HTTP request with two X-Tenant values ("", "tenant-xyz"). Identity-proxy picks first entry and fails. When values reversed ("tenant-xyz", ""), pick first entry and success. Behavior deterministic: first header wins.

Checked code path: identity-proxy uses http.Header.Get which returns the first value; no existing deduplication or fallback to non-empty values. Confirmed in repo: identity/http.go line 312 (header parsing comment).

Cross-check with scheduler: Customer's batch worker library sets header list by passing an empty header entry when a template variable is unset; combined with edge folding, empty value is preserved as first entry.
mitigation_and_workaround: Short-term (customer): Add an ingress rule to collapse X-Tenant header values and drop empty entries. Sample nginx rule provided to customer in chat.
Short-term (support): We can apply a tenant header rewrite at the customer's private control-plane proxy if customer approves (requires maintenance window).

Long-term (engineering): Implement fallback logic in identity-proxy to prefer the first non-empty header value when multiple are present and log the original header array for diagnostics. Proposed PR created.
resolution: 2026-03-14 - Partial resolution: Customer applied ingress rewrite; overnight jobs resumed. Issue remains open for engineering fix to avoid operator-managed workarounds.

Code change planned: PR https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/2298 implements header dedupe and prefers last non-empty tenant value as configured; includes unit tests and an opt-in feature flag 'IDENTITY_HEADER_DEDUPE'.
Follow-up: Schedule change-control with Datawave to roll the identity-proxy config flag in private clusters. Add e2e test in CI for duplicate-tenant-header scenarios.
Status: Waiting on Customer for sign-off of production roll and on Eng for code review and staging rollout.
